{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "Sjors",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "tested with legacy GUI; suggested covering new interface via loadtxoutset RPC"
    },
    {
      "login": "ryanofsky",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected to passing AutoFile across process boundaries; accepted path-based interface refactor"
    },
    {
      "login": "pinheadmz",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK and code review ACK; raised progress notification frequency and RPC redundancy which were fixed"
    },
    {
      "login": "fanquake",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "reported CI build failure and asked for inline replies to review comments"
    },
    {
      "login": "sedited",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Approach ACK and requested a rebase"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:2248934018",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Passing an AutoFile across process boundaries complicates IPC and lacks clean separation between GUI and node",
      "quote": "if the GUI & node are running in separate processes, it could be a awkward for the gui process to create an AutoFile object and pass it to the node like this.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author refactored to pass fs::path, which reviewer approved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2249012242",
        "rc:2251982022"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2252027721",
      "status_by_quote": "I think b464f388197c5c31937d309d817d38c4b4849a91 is an improvement over previous de11e3b89f8aba9a90a3419086807e5fee0f941"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2329435219",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Use the new snapshot interface in the loadtxoutset RPC to add test coverage",
      "quote": "a good way to add test coverage to this new interface would be to use it in the `loadtxoutset` RPC.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "implemented in 30d9bdb and confirmed inline",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2330771778",
        "rc:2349555648"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2349555648",
      "status_by_quote": "refactored `loadtxoutset` to utilize the new `snapshot` interface..."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2709768975",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Signaling progress updates per coin will fire over 100 million times on mainnet",
      "quote": "This will fire 100 million times during a mainnet snapshot load. Is that overkill?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "progress updates batched every 100k coins",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2729475716",
        "rc:2854628822"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2854628822",
      "status_by_quote": "addressed the snapshot load progress notification to batch progress updates for every 100,000 coins processed"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3102797827",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Redundant file open and metadata parse in the RPC handler duplicates activate()",
      "quote": "If the file can't be opened for reading, or metadata can't be parsed, won't that come up in `activate()` on line 3433?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "duplication removed in refactor returning util::Result from activate()",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3119624631",
        "rc:3343973156"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3343973156",
      "status_by_quote": "Yes! That duplication is gone in af0c253. File open, metadata parse, and activation all live in SnapshotImpl::activate()"
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:3155500225",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "tested the mainnet snapshot load with the QML gui branch built on top of this",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "tested",
      "areas": [
        "gui-qml"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "c:3265507664",
      "verdict": "Approach ACK",
      "reason": "Approach ACK",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:3195338293",
      "verdict": "",
      "reason": "At first glance this looks very reasonable. I also tested it in the (current) GUI with https://github.com/bitcoin-core/gui/pull/870",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "tested",
      "areas": [
        "gui"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "r:3683920243",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "The new interface and signal handlers are fairly straight-forward and follow existing patterns. Consuming the new interface in the `loadtxoutset` RPC ensures it is covered by tests.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": [
        "interfaces",
        "loadtxoutset RPC"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "re-review from reviewers following the refactor and recent rebases",
      "id": "c:5820289583"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Added Sjors' suggestion to cover the interface via RPC. All raised objections regarding IPC boundaries, progress notification frequency, and redundant RPC metadata parsing have been addressed and fixed."
}
